label: SPEC/EST — not live telemetry

hardware.axle1: diesel keeps ONE rear drive axle
hardware.axle2: two Tesla-class compact drive units, one per wheel — those ARE the Power Pods
hardware.tesla: physics analog only (Semi / Model S–class plug motors). NOT a Tesla PO. No badge.
hardware.cooling_hv: Orange HV class, liquid cool, bolted serviceable snap-on
hardware.energy_source: snap-in trailer battery modules (and/or small tractor junction). NOT a wall plug on the cab.

energy_paths.dock: bank under slab → pad face → shoe → jumper UP inside landing-gear legs → trailer junction → snap-in modules → hitch hop → Power Pod / BEV pack. Skin PV → modules with pad idle.
energy_paths.road: axle-2 pods propel + regen into same modules. Regen is NOT the dock path. Do not paint lightning at wheels as the pad.
energy_paths.gen1_hitch: manual HV hitch hop + HVIL interlock. HVIL open = pods offline, no green. Auto-mate is Gen 2.
energy_paths.gen1_charge_money: charge the DROPPED trailer on the pad (never crosses fifth wheel). That ships first.

fleet_tags: BEV SEMI (own drive, no diesel, no pods)

software_half.slip: per-wheel torque/slip; electric ms; PWM tens of kHz; traction loop slower than PWM, far faster than air ABS/engine brake 10–50 Hz
software_half.diesel_limit: diesel axle cannot torque-vector; pods can (ice/snow/wet DFW/light trailer/split-mu)
software_half.logging: log slip/torque; insurance discount is a PATH if log trustworthy; no % invented

ui_locks.colors: slip-working green; pod red = fault not ice; ice is weather
ui_locks.hero: pods only on DIESEL+POD tractor; two units axle 2; no center lump; orange cable not halo

mpg.closest_analog: NREL Coca-Cola Eaton hybrid +13.7% in-service; +22–30% city EST; ~0–6% highway
mpg.other_analogs_file: HYBRID-MPG.txt (Range Energy trailer axle, UC Davis, SAE P2 — labeled, not kit mpg)

pad_interface_consumed_not_owned.gen1: mechanical plunger/rocker; rubber = recycled-tire crumb housing not conductor
pad_interface_consumed_not_owned.lamps: CONDUCTING green / IDLE dim / WORN amber / FAULT red
